resources.string: Bubble for dictating and inserting text in any app

Amber uses this service to show the dictation bubble and to type your dictation into the field you are writing in. For that it reads which app is in front and whether a text field has focus (to show or hide the bubble), where the keyboard is (to keep the bubble above it), and - only when inserting a dictation - the text already in that field, so the new words fit in at the cursor. None of this is stored or sent anywhere: only your recording goes to the speech recognition you chose, and with cleanup its text to the cleanup you chose. Right after you switch on something Amber sent you to Android\'s settings for - this service, or battery use without limits - it brings Amber back to the front. Beyond that it never taps, swipes or acts for you.
